Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Overview Trailer — Nintendo Switch 2
The Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game launches September 17, 2026, only on Nintendo Switch 2. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-switch-2/

Travel through time to gather allies and defeat the demon god Balor. Test your tactical prowess in battle as you guide four heroes on their interwoven journeys from past to present. Together, you’ll save the future from ruin—or fall trying.

FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE – Demo Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Play the free demo for FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, available now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6006aZv60

Return to the pixel-art world of FINAL FANTASY in this reimagined adventure! The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon. Pre-order the full game today or try out the first chapter with the free demo!
